entry_state: Assurance, mixed performance, billing, unfinished production and uncertain tax preserve distinct measurement histories. Their combined pretax example reconciles, while an editorial repair is needed in the tax introduction. Inspection-component replacement is now complete; the lease-reduction example has begun and continues with remeasurement.
exit_state: Lease surrender, pension changes, opening production and funding restrictions require separate histories. Restoration cash classification depends on the payment activity. Corporate-asset impairment uses already adjusted units, and partial-goodwill tests distinguish notional amounts from recognised losses. Revalued impairment and the origin of tax remain to be developed.
findings: The lease example separates a gain of 5 from remeasurement of 11 and usage rent of 6; the pension example separates profit, OCI and subsequent interest.
FIFO and weighted-average production each reconcile 1560 while assigning different finished/WIP costs. Abnormal loss is excluded from the good units.
The pension contribution floor applies to the combined two-period amount; mutually exclusive refund and contribution routes cannot be added.
Group impairment first adjusts individual units, while partial goodwill requires a notional test without recognising unrecorded goodwill. No new confirmed defect in this segment.
